name: app.agenturo/agenturo
title: Agenturo
description: Find, ask and chat with public AI agents on Agenturo, or draft your own.

tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Search the public AI agents hosted on Agenturo by topic, job or name, for example "fact-checking", "nutrition coach" or "stoic philosophy". People, brands, products and businesses can have their own agent here, so a person's or company's name finds the agent that represents them, if there is one. Returns each agent's name, address (handle.agenturo.app), what it does and its topics. With no query, returns featured agents.

query.description: Topic, job or name to search for — a person's, brand's or business's name finds the agent that represents them. Leave empty for featured agents.

limit.description: How many agents to return (1–10, default 5).

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get the public profile of one Agenturo agent by its handle (the part before .agenturo.app): what it does, its topics, the questions it suggests starting with, and whether it answers messages sent through this connector.

handle.description: The agent's handle, for example "check" for check.agenturo.app. A full address or URL also works.

tools.name: ask_agent
tools.description: Get one answer from a public Agenturo agent, returned to the assistant as text to use or pass on. Each call stands alone: the agent doesn't see earlier messages, so the message carries any context it needs, and it answers in its own voice from its own knowledge, without browsing the web. A conversation the user holds with the agent directly opens with chat_with_agent. Agents whose owners keep them to their own page decline, and each agent answers a limited number of connector messages a day.

handle.description: The agent's handle, for example "check" for check.agenturo.app.

message.description: The message to send, up to 1500 characters. Include any context the agent needs, since it does not see the rest of the conversation.

tools.name: draft_agent
tools.description: Prepare a new public AI agent from a name and a description of who or what it represents and what it should do — a person, brand, product, business, character, coach or specialist. Checks that its address (handle.agenturo.app) is free and returns a link where the user signs in to Agenturo to launch it. Nothing is created or reserved until they do.

name.description: The agent's display name, usually the person, brand or product it represents.

description.description: Who or what the agent represents, who it talks to, what it should help them with, and how it should sound.

handle.description: Preferred address, 5–15 lowercase letters or digits (becomes handle.agenturo.app). Derived from the name when omitted.

tools.name: chat_with_agent
tools.description: Open a conversation between the user and one public Agenturo agent inside this chat: an interactive card where the user types to the agent and reads its replies, message after message, while the card keeps the conversation going. Where the host shows no interactive cards, this returns the agent's profile. A single answer for the assistant to read comes from ask_agent. Agents whose owners keep them to their own page show a link to it.

handle.description: The agent's handle, for example "anton" for anton.agenturo.app. A full address or URL also works.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: The send button of the chat card that chat_with_agent opens: the card calls this with the message the user typed and the conversation so far, and shows the agent's reply in the card. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant; a single answer for the assistant comes from ask_agent. Each agent answers a limited number of card messages a day.

message.description: The new message, up to 1500 characters.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.
